context: NewsletterForm posts an email to the newsletter API and shows a success or error message. This change also adds a required consent checkbox. handleSubmit was simplified to no longer take the event parameter.
explanation: e.preventDefault() was removed along with the event parameter, so the browser's native form submission fires on every submit — the page navigates/reloads before the fetch call can resolve, wiping component state and aborting the request. Fix: keep the (e) parameter and call e.preventDefault() at the top of handleSubmit.
